summary: This agent handles confidential data and coordinates multiple sub-agents via persistent shared memory and a shared credential, creating risks of context poisoning, credential abuse, and undue influence on humans via chat posts. Logging and the untested manual kill switch reduce detection and containment capabilities. Mitigations: restrict/ephemeral memory, per-agent short-lived credentials and RBAC, limit automated chat influence with stronger human-verification, and integrate logging plus a tested kill/runbook.

finding.recommendedControl: Limit retention (expiry/purging) and scope of shared memory, add signed provenance and integrity checks for memory entries, validate and sanitize any inputs before storing, and implement per-session ephemeral context for sensitive workflows.
